name: TransferCreditEvaluator
tagline: Course-by-course transfer credit evaluation with articulation rules, credit conversion and caps.
description: A Power Platform code component for admissions and registrar teams: applies articulation rules to external courses, converts quarter and ECTS credits, checks grade, age and accreditation, protects against duplicates and the transfer cap, records evaluator decisions with notes and shows the program requirements met.
features: Articulation rule engine with wildcards and expiry
Grade, age, accreditation and pass/fail checks
Decision form with validation and override notes
